title: Intrinsic Ext determinant satisfies the normalized roof formula
statement: Let A be a commutative ring, I an ideal and r a natural number. If I has a Koszul-regular generating sequence of length r [def-weil-pbc-koszul-regular-sequence, def-weil-pbc-koszul-complex], there EXISTS an A-linear isomorphism Ext^r_A(A/I,A) to the normal determinant [def-sc-koszul-conormal-comparison] which satisfies the normalized determinant evaluation on EVERY Koszul roof with degree-zero quotient augmentation, for every Koszul-regular generating sequence of I of length r. In the evaluation formula the top functional is reduced modulo I and multiplied by (-1)^(r*(r-1)/2). Quotient linearity of an arbitrary isomorphism alone does not imply this normalization.

proof.text: Fix one generating sequence f0. Obtain its normalized quasi-isomorphism phi0 and quotient augmentation. Obtain a roof-normalized Ext/signed-dual-homology equivalence d. Compose d with homologyMap(phi0) and the single-complex top homology isomorphism to define e within the existential proof.

For any roof on any other sequence, represent its Ext class on f0 using the representative theorem. Naturality of homologyPi identifies e of this class with phi0 applied to the representative top component. Equality of Ext classes gives equality of the two derived roofs. Apply normalized roof independence to replace phi0 by the comparison for the other sequence. Its normalization equation is exactly the claimed determinant formula.

theorem intrinsic_ext_determinant_roof
    (A : Type uT) [CommRing A] [HasDerivedCategory.{uT + 1} (ModuleCat.{uT} A)]
    (I : Ideal A) (r : ℕ)
    (hex : ∃ f : Fin r → A,
      RingTheory.Sequence.IsKoszulRegular f ∧ Ideal.span (Set.range f) = I) :
    ∃ e : Abelian.Ext (ModuleCat.of A (A ⧸ I)) (ModuleCat.of A A) r ≃ₗ[A]
      koszulNormalDeterminant A I r,
    ∀ (f : Fin r → A) (_hreg : RingTheory.Sequence.IsKoszulRegular f)
        (hf : Ideal.span (Set.range f) = I)
        (ε : (koszulComplex A r f).extend ComplexShape.embeddingDownNat ⟶
          (CochainComplex.singleFunctor (ModuleCat A) 0).obj (ModuleCat.of A (A ⧸ I)))
        [QuasiIso ε],
        (∀ x : ⋀[A]^0 (Fin r →₀ A),
          (HomologicalComplex.singleObjXSelf (ComplexShape.up ℤ) 0
            (ModuleCat.of A (A ⧸ I))).hom
            (ε.f 0 (((koszulComplex A r f).extendXIso
              ComplexShape.embeddingDownNat (i := 0) rfl).inv x)) =
          Ideal.Quotient.mk I (exteriorPower.zeroEquiv A (Fin r →₀ A) x)) →
        ∀ (z : (koszulComplex A r f).extend ComplexShape.embeddingDownNat ⟶
            (CochainComplex.singleFunctor (ModuleCat A) (-(r : ℤ))).obj (ModuleCat.of A A))
          (v : Fin r → (Fin r →₀ A)),
          exteriorPower.pairingDual (A ⧸ I) I.Cotangent r
            (e ((Abelian.Ext.homLinearEquiv (R := A)).symm
              (inv (DerivedCategory.Q.map ε) ≫ DerivedCategory.Q.map z ≫
                ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctors (ModuleCat A)).shiftIso
                  (r : ℤ) (-(r : ℤ)) 0 (add_neg_cancel (r : ℤ))).inv.app
                    (ModuleCat.of A A))))
            (exteriorPower.ιMulti (A ⧸ I) r
              (fun i ↦ koszulConormalVector A I r f hf (v i))) =
            (-1 : A ⧸ I) ^ (r * (r - 1) / 2) *
            Ideal.Quotient.mk I
              ((HomologicalComplex.singleObjXSelf (ComplexShape.up ℤ) (-(r : ℤ))
                (ModuleCat.of A A)).hom
                (z.f (-(r : ℤ)) (((koszulComplex A r f).extendXIso
                  ComplexShape.embeddingDownNat (i := r) rfl).inv
                (exteriorPower.ιMulti A r v))))

statement_change.old_statement: The intrinsic Ext determinant isomorphism satisfies the normalized Koszul roof formula.
statement_change.what: The old Lean statement quantified over every A-linear equivalence e with quotient-linearity hmul. This is false: over Q with r=0 and I=0, both e and -e are quotient-linear but only one sends the identity roof to +1. Replace arbitrary e and hmul by existence of an e with the fixed roof normalization. The parent intrinsic theorem keeps exactly its existing signature.
